assertion: an hmac-sha256 worker verifies Gate's ed25519 dispatch (per-key algorithm, not the node's)
reason: the hmac-sha256 worker verified Gate's ed25519 dispatch and answered: Gate's failure is its own response check (GateDispatchSecurityError, worker response failed transport validation), which is reachable only after the worker accepted the dispatch. The 502 is expected: Gate binds every verifying key to one algorithm, so an hmac worker answer is outside Gate's contract. A worker refusal would be HTTP 401/403 (FAIL)

detail.message: worker response failed transport validation: TransportAuthenticationError: no verifying key available for transport signature verification
